name: Beat & Dungeon
author: Gonzi Audio
summary: A role-playing game for beatmakers: the project is a dungeon, each track a room, and a D20 sets the rule for the next one (sound, tempo, curses, creatures, gold to spend at the merchant). It plays no sound itself: it guides your beat. English. Built with the Akai MPC Plugin SDK; Gen1 and Gen2.
